defs.def: an aircraft without wings that has large blades on top that go round. It can fly straight up from the ground and can also stay in one position in the air 直升机

ex.s: He told me a helicopter was on its way，but it would be 30 minutes before it arrived.
ex.t: 他告诉我一架直升机正在赶来，但要过30分钟才能到达。

ex.s: We just had drinking water that was sent to us by helicopter, but it was never enough.
ex.t: 我们只有直升机送来的饮用水，但从来都不够。

ex.s: The first step involved poison being dropped from helicopters.
ex.t: 第一步涉及从直升机投下毒药。

ex.s: Many children born in the 1990s and 2000s were raised by “helicopter parents” who were always there to guide and help them with a busy schedule filled with homework and extra-curricular activities such as dancing, drawing, or sports.
ex.t: 许多在1990年代和2000年代出生的儿童是由 " 直升机家长 " 抚养的，他们总是在那里指导和帮助他们忙碌的日程安排，其中充满家庭作业和课外活动，如舞蹈、绘画或运动。

ex.s: Two helicopters and eight planes are also ready to fly anyone who becomes seriously ill to hospital In pairs, discuss why people participate in very challenging sporting events.
ex.t: 还有两架直升机和八架飞机随时准备将任何重症病人送往医院。两人一组讨论人们为什么参加非常具有挑战性的体育赛事。
